name: Campazas (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of purple, white and purple, the white edged with thin yellow lines and charged with the crowned municipal arms of Campazas (a tower, a lion and the bars of Aragon).
history: Municipal flag of Campazas; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: thin lines edging the white stripe and the bars of the arms
Campazas arms — tower, lion and the bars of Aragon
